name: mobile-security
description: Use when the user asks about mobile app security, Keychain/Keystore secure storage, certificate or SSL pinning, root/jailbreak detection, Play Integrity, App Attest, R8 obfuscation or OWASP MASVS. Produces a hardened storage, transport and integrity setup. Not for biometric login UX (use mobile-biometrics) or web security (use frontend-security).
